findings.summary: When a form dialog opens automatically after a validation error, closing it may return focus to the page body instead of its trigger.
findings.fix: On dialog close, explicitly return focus to its associated trigger when that trigger remains available; retain the error-summary focus while the dialog is open.
findings.evidence: The page-load path invokes dialogTrigger.click(), which does not focus the trigger before showModal(); the error summary is then focused inside the dialog.

passed: The applicant, review, and resignation launchers are generated as semantic buttons with dialog labels and controls.
User-opened dialogs focus the first form field; native modal dialogs contain keyboard focus.
Each dialog has a semantic Close button, and Escape closes an open dialog.
notes: Static source review only; no page-level keyboard scan was run.
